notes: Each theme has its own editor: it shows only the tabs that theme has (Resolution, Layouts where the theme has them, Layer order from Glamour, Settings, Touch). The Theme and Mood tabs are gone.
Ganymede's three options (Detailed, Simple, Blackfield) are picked right on its Portals card, with pictures, like the other portals. Blackfield shows as awaiting your OK.
Dia's three looks (Classic, Widgets, Ring) are picked on its Portals card.

The Portals tab (was Portals (panels)) lists every installed theme in groups you can fold: Free, AIDA64, Glamour themes, Premium. A group with nothing in it is hidden, and Sigil remembers which you left open.
Ganymede no longer wears another theme's Showcase look: it goes back to what it wore before.
